language.name: English
settings.title: Settings
settings.decorationHint: Draw the title bar in the app. On KDE, first add a “No titlebar and frame” window rule for this app, then turn this switch on: the decoration protocol has no “undecorated” value, so the app cannot detect it on its own. Wayland only.
settings.perfHint: Shows CPU, memory, goroutine count and frame rate in the top bar. All figures come from the Go runtime (cgo work is not included). Sampling runs only while visible and stops as soon as it is turned off.
settings.proxyHint: http://, https:// or socks5:// address, optionally with user:password. Leave empty for a direct connection.
settings.proxyInvalid: Enter a full proxy address, for example http://127.0.0.1:8080.
settings.proxyUnset: No proxy is configured. Add one in Settings → Interface → Network before using this option.
settings.accountIntro: Create an OAuth client of type “Desktop app” in Google Cloud Console and enable the Gmail API, then paste its client ID and secret here. The app receives the callback on 127.0.0.1, so no redirect URI has to be registered.
shortcut.hint: Shortcuts work while no text field has focus; Ctrl+W and Ctrl+Q work anywhere. While a panel is open, only Esc, Ctrl+W and Ctrl+Q act.
sidebar.labelsUnavailable: Label management is not available yet.
list.emptyHint: Try another folder, or adjust your search.
reader.emptyTitle: Select a conversation to start reading
reader.emptyHint: Pick a conversation from the list and the whole thread appears here.
reader.noPlainText: This message has no plain-text part. Open the HTML version in your browser.
